prompts.review_digest:
Write short messages for a test set. The messages are short customer reviews of a product, each mainly about one thing.

Write 12 different messages for each of these labels:
- price: mainly about the price or value for money
- quality: mainly about the product's quality
- delivery: mainly about the delivery
- service: mainly about customer service

Each message is one to three sentences of natural English, as a real person would write it. Vary the wording, length and style. A careful reader must be able to tell which label a message belongs to, and it must not fit any other label.

Reply with JSON only, no code fence: an object with the keys "price", "quality", "delivery", "service", each mapping to an array of 12 strings.
